recommendation_text: Prefer modern high-yielding, short-duration rice varieties tolerant of environmental stresses; select according to the official technical recommendations.
notes: General selection principle; does not rank a variety for a specific parcel or confirm seasonal seed availability.

recommendation_text: Under saline-soil conditions: early planting is recommended from the last week of April through 10 May.
notes: Only apply to saline-soil context; do not treat as a universal Kafr El-Sheikh calendar.

recommendation_text: Under saline-soil conditions: seed rate is 60-80 kg/feddan for ordinary varieties, depending on soil salinity.
notes: Salinity-dependent range; the source excerpt does not provide a formula for choosing within the range.

recommendation_text: Under saline-soil conditions: seed rate is 15 kg/feddan for hybrid rice.
notes: Salinity-section value only; validate sowing method and current hybrid recommendation before operational use.

recommendation_text: For saline-soil conditions, direct seeding is preferred; if transplanting, locate the nursery near irrigation and on the least saline part of the land.
notes: Conditional agronomic guidance; not a recommendation for every parcel.

recommendation_text: Nitrogen fertilizer amount stated by ARC for Yasmine, Sakha 104, and Sakha Super 106: 200 kg ammonium sulfate (20%) or 100 kg urea (46%) per feddan.
notes: Alternative fertilizer products are retained verbatim; do not interpret these alternatives as a numeric range. Verify cultivar names and edition against the full bulletin before operational use.

recommendation_text: Nitrogen fertilizer amount stated by ARC for Sakha 101, Sakha 107, Sakha 108, Giza 177, Giza 178, Giza 179, Giza 182, and Egyptian Hybrid 1: 300 kg ammonium sulfate (20%) or 150 kg urea (46%) per feddan.
notes: Alternative fertilizer products are retained verbatim; do not interpret these alternatives as a numeric range. Verify cultivar names and edition against the full bulletin before operational use.

recommendation_text: For listed non-hybrid varieties, apply two-thirds before the second ploughing and mix into soil; apply the remaining one-third 65-70 days after sowing (seed-soak date), with the field dried for three days before the later application.
notes: The bulletin excerpt distinguishes hybrid management; full text should be reviewed before implementing all timing details.

recommendation_text: During nursery preparation, ARC excerpt recommends 1 kg zinc sulfate per qirat of nursery; if omitted there and deficiency symptoms appear, 10 kg zinc sulfate per feddan may be applied to the permanent field after puddling and mixed into soil.
notes: Two context-specific rates with different area units and application conditions; values retained in prose and not normalized into one rate.

recommendation_text: Recommended rice seed rate stated in the May 2025 extension bulletin: 40-50 kg per feddan; use trusted seed and do not mix seed lots from different sources.
notes: Season-specific bulletin; check the selected variety and planting method before operational use.

recommendation_text: Soak rice seed for 24-48 hours before incubation until sprouting.
Incubate soaked seed for 24-48 hours; extend incubation when weather is cold, only until sprouting so roots do not elongate and break.
Maintain clear water 2-3 cm above the nursery soil surface for the initial five days after broadcasting seed, then drain and follow the bulletin's nursery watering sequence.
notes: Nursery-stage guidance; this is not the field-season irrigation schedule.

recommendation_text: After the initial nursery drainage and aeration sequence, repeat nursery irrigation every 4-6 days, draining the nursery well one day before irrigation.
notes: Nursery-stage guidance; not a field-season irrigation schedule and not directly convertible to pump minutes.

recommendation_text: ARC lists Giza 177|Giza 178|Giza 179|Egyptian Hybrid 1|Sakha 104|Sakha 108|Egyptian Jasmine as varieties for climate-change adaptation.
notes: National bulletin list; not a Kafr El Sheikh field-specific ranking or current seed-availability confirmation.

recommendation_text: For dry direct-seeded rice, the bulletin gives 1-20 May as the preferred sowing window.
notes: Applies to dry direct seeding; do not reuse as a transplanting window without the relevant method-specific recommendation.

recommendation_text: The bulletin reports 10-15% lower irrigation water use for dry direct seeding compared with manual transplanting.
notes: Published comparative claim; not a locally calibrated saving factor and must not be applied as a guaranteed reduction in field water volume.

recommendation_text: For dry direct seeding, irrigate lightly every 4-5 days, adjusting to soil moisture and air temperature, until about 30 days after sowing.
notes: Method-specific interval; the bulletin calls for adjustment to soil moisture and temperature. Not pump-runtime data.

recommendation_text: After the early dry-sowing phase, the bulletin recommends shallow flooding and increasing water depth gradually as plants grow.
notes: No numeric water depth or volume specified in the cited excerpt; do not invent one.

recommendation_text: For dry direct seeding, apply 100 kg/feddan of superphosphate before tillage.
notes: Method-specific fertilizer recommendation; verify product concentration and current extension guidance before farm use.

recommendation_text: For dry direct seeding, use 2-3 urea bags/feddan according to the cultivar; the bulletin describes three split applications tied to flooding and panicle initiation.
notes: The cited excerpt specifies staged timing; bag mass/product formulation must be confirmed before translating this to kilograms.

recommendation_text: For dry direct seeding, apply 10 kg/feddan zinc sulphate before permanent flooding, around 25-30 days after sowing.
notes: Method-specific; product concentration and soil zinc status are not captured by this database.

recommendation_text: During hot periods, the bulletin advises avoiding irrigation at midday and maintaining suitable water management around roots.
notes: Qualitative heat-period guidance; no numeric volume or exact time-of-day schedule is provided.
